item.title: pyRMV: Reusable, Cross-model Validation for Computational Science
item.description: arXiv:2608.09956v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a model-agnostic approach to the validation of computational models, and a python library containing a suite of validations for mouse primary visual cortex models. By viewing the model not as a stand-in for the target system, but instead as a generator of predicted system properties, this approach allows validations to easily generalize to many different models, while also making them comparatively simple to write. Several limitations of this approach are outlined alongside possible means of addressing them. This presents an important step in addressing what we consider the most important problem in computational science: the standardization of model validation.
item.dc:creator: Hugo Dictus, Eduard Subert, Armando Romani, Henry Markram
